title: BEMED - Zero Waste Montenegro
shortDescription: Helping government institutions manage their environmental footprint.
description:
Helping government institutions manage their environmental footprint by building a web application that allows them to register and monitor expenses related to single-use plastics.
This project was developed as part of an Erasmus+ Blended Intensive Programme (BIP) in collaboration with international students from Hogeschool VIVES (Belgium), Zealand – Sjællands Erhvervsakademi (Denmark), and Hogeschool Inholland (Netherlands). The project combined weeks of remote teamwork with an in-person session at Universidad Politécnica de Madrid.
